events.title: Sonnedix signs tailor-made financial product with Endesa
events.body: Sonnedix has signed a tailor-made financial product with Endesa to hedge its long-term positions.

events.title: Endesa shares slip after power utility’s second-quarter earnings miss estimates
events.body: Investing.com - Madrid-listed shares in Endesa (BME:ELE) fell in early trading on Tuesday after the power group posted second-quarter earnings that fell short of expectations.
